text:
At the tip of the pine a bird
+sings, arrested,
+trembling above its trill.
+
+
+It rises, an arrow, on the branch,
+vanishes among wings
+and pours itself out in music.
+
+
+The bird is a splinter
+that sings and burns alive
+inside a yellow note.
+
+
+I lift my eyes: there is nothing.
+Silence upon the branch,
+upon the broken branch.

translation.title: The Branch
translation.editorial_note: The song’s metamorphoses—bird, arrow, splinter, flame, yellow note—are kept swift and physical; the repeated branch closes on the silence left by flight.
